name: Mörksugga
body:
MÖRKSUGGA
CR 8

This creature is something of a hazy shadow, but when you focus your vision it resembles an adorable, black-furred piglet with long ears and tufted tail, standing upright and gazing at you with human-like eyes of bright violet.

XP 4,800
N Small fey
Init +3; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision, see in darkness; Perception +21

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)
hp 86 (16d6+32)
Fort +6, Ref +11, Will +13
DR 5/cold iron; SR 19

OFFENSE

Speed 25 ft.
Melee touch +10 (4d12)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 11th; concentration +16)

At will—detect magic, ghost sound, mage hand, invisibility, prestidigitation, silent image
3/day—charm animal (DC 16), charm person (DC 18), enthrall (DC 17)
1/day—deeper darkness, slow (DC 18)

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 13, Wis 20, Cha 21
Base Atk +6; CMB +4; CMD 18
Feats Ability Focus (charm person), Combat Expertise, Dodge, Mobility, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (charm person, silent image), Spring Attack, Weapon Focus (touch attacks)
Skills Bluff +21, Diplomacy +21, Knowledge (local) +17, Perception +21, Sense Motive +21, Sleight of Hand +20, Stealth +24
Languages Common, Sylvan
SQ aura of darkness, dark step

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Darkness (Sp)

A mörksugga emits an aura of darkness as the spell in a 20-foot radius. It can suppress or resume the aura (even if dispelled) as a standard action.

Dark Step (Su)

As a move action, a mörksugga can teleport up to 60 feet to a location it can see.

Touch of Darkness (Su)

A mörksugga’s touch deals 4d12 force damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold land
Organization solitary, pair, or lurk (3–6)
Treasure standard

The mörksugga is an enigmatic creature. Some say it can protect against dark forces, others that it is a dark force itself. Most of the time, it is invisible, silently watching and listening. It is rarely seen to move; instead it simply disappears and reappears in difference places, often when no one is looking. It is said to possess great wisdom from all the time it spends silently observing; but rarely does it seem interested in sharing its secrets.

On the rare occasions it allows itself to be seen, the mörksugga reveals itself as a dark, oval-shaped creature with a pig-like body and cat-like ears. It is thought to have hands, but no one has ever seen them, only felt (what seemed to be) their touch. A mörksugga is just over 2 feet tall and weighs 50 pounds.
